headline: Mercado Libre Opens Major Logistics Center in Argentina with $115 Million Investment
summary: Mercado Libre inaugurated its largest logistics center in Argentina, located in Escobar, backed by a $115 million investment to process up to 130,000 packages daily.
why: Investments in automated fulfillment centers enhance delivery speeds, lower operational costs, and support scaling e-commerce platforms across Latin America.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre Inc
impacts.why: Expanding logistics infrastructure enhances fulfillment capacity and operational efficiency for the region's leading e-commerce platform.
